description: An organization's subscription, how many tracked queries its projects the caller can access have, and how many checks they are projected to run per month. Plan entitlements (tracked-query and check limits) are included for owners only, as in the web app; for other members "entitlements" is null. For a member restricted to selected projects, the plan, billing cycle, check budget, consumption and deactivation reason in "subscription" are null too. Use it before creating tracked queries or raising check frequency, to stay within the plan.
name: get_usage
title: Get plan and usage
